_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-iq on the `klt sim` harness (issue #414, part of #412). Mechanics: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py; argument: this file.
Claim: Through the co-simulated closed-loop schematic (bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup, trim-bearing core at trim_code=128, wired as design/bandgap_top.sch), total vdd quiescent supply current (Iq) across the 45-point PVT grid, reported as a magnitude and confirmed settled (|i(Vvdd)(3ms)-i(Vvdd)(2ms)| <= 100 nA) at a genuine closed-loop operating point (startup released, loop closed within 20 mV, fb not railed). Evidence only: NOT compared against the draft Iq target as a pass/fail verdict (see the experiment README).
Netlist provenance: design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice (trim-bearing, trim_code=128), design/netlist/bandgap_amp.spice and design/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice, carried verbatim into sim/closed-loop-iq/testbench/closed_loop_iq.body.spice.tmpl (XMSENSE w= read from the live startup netlist).
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
